description: Queue a photo note to be saved as a draft, after human approval. Does NOT post. Returns a queue id.

aiGenerated.description: Required. true if you wrote or polished the title or body: RedNote's own AI label (笔记含AI合成内容) is then set. false only when the user gave you the exact text.

body.description: note body; line breaks and emoji are kept; no # here

images.description: absolute paths to JPEG, PNG or WebP files, in posting order; the first is the cover

topics.description: up to 5 topics without #, added as RedNote topics at the end of the body

name: rednote_create_draft
